Subject: Great meeting at AI Fintech Summit - Redwood + FintechX

Hi Sophie - it was great to meet you at the AI Fintech Summit yesterday. I enjoyed our chat about latency-sensitive fraud detection and the token-cost challenges you mentioned for real-time scoring.

Quick recap from my side:
- Redwood is focused on predictable inference economics and sub-100ms tail latency for short-sequence scoring use cases.
- We have dedicated GPU pools and routing policies that teams use to guarantee latency SLAs for inference.
- Typical wins we see: 2-3x cost reduction on scoring workloads with caching+batches, and easier fallbacks to cheaper model variants during peak traffic.

Next steps I suggested: share a 15-20 minute demo tailored to your scoring pipeline and a one-pager on expected unit costs for 10k qps. I attached a short quickstart that outlines model variants and quantization options.

Are you available next week for a quick demo? I can bring Camila (solutions engineer) to walk through a prospective integration plan.

Best,
Marissa
